_comment: Mirrors CLAUDE.md section 3 and docs/Phases.md. This file is a SUMMARY and is not authoritative — when it disagrees with docs/Memory.md, Memory.md wins and this file is the thing to fix. Update it in the same commit as any phase change. 'does' is one short sentence shown under each stage; keep it that way (owner, 2026-09-15). Measured numbers are NOT written here — the page reads them from the seed reports via /api/results.

stages.name: Normalize
stages.does: Strips leading and trailing whitespace from every line.

stages.name: Parse
stages.does: Parses the code with the grammar (C or C++) that fits it best.

stages.name: Graphs
stages.does: Builds the code graph: syntax tree, control flow and data flow.

stages.name: Tokenize
stages.does: Splits the code into CodeBERT tokens, in 512-token windows.

stages.name: Line axis
stages.does: How many graph nodes and tokens land on each line.

stages.name: Semantic model
stages.does: CodeBERT reads the code as text and scores each line. This is the model behind the Findings tab.

stages.name: Structural model
stages.does: A graph neural network (GCN) reads the code graph and scores each line.

stages.name: Fusion
stages.does: Combines both models. Measured on the dataset only; not run on your code.

stages.name: Localization head
stages.does: Calibrated line scores with a cut-off chosen on validation data. Measured on the dataset only; not run on your code.

stages.name: Explanation
stages.does: Says why a line was flagged, from what the model looked at.

stages.name: Evaluation
stages.does: Final benchmark numbers against other tools.
